result.title: Ultra-Lightweight 3D Medical Image Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation in Label-Scarce Domains
result.comment: This is a four pages paper having 3 figures and is submitted to ISBI2027
result.summary: Mamba is a neural network architecture that reduces computational complexity, and has been shown to be effective for 3D medical image segmentation. However, existing models still remain computationally expensive. We propose compressing Mamba by distillation while achieving competitive performance. Specifically, we demonstrate compression of a 139M-parameter SegMamba-V2 teacher into a lightweight TinyUNet3D student with about 0.96M parameters, achieving about 145$\times$ compression with a performance drop of just over one Dice point. We further investigate the utility of knowledge distillation in a range of data-labeling scenarios under identical experimental settings, and show that its advantage is most prominent when labeled data is scarce. To demonstrate the generalizability of our approach, experiments are conducted on three datasets: BraTS 2023, MSD Spleen and MSD Hippocampus. The code for TinyUNet3D is publicly available at: https://github.com/2802990u/tinyunet3d-dist-kd.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文将 139M 参数的 SegMamba-V2 教师模型蒸馏到约 0.96M 参数的 TinyUNet3D 学生模型，在三个 3D 医学分割数据集上考察标注数据稀缺时的压缩效果与性能损失。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作聚焦 3D 医学分割的模型压缩与标注稀缺下的蒸馏，不涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据获取、动态计算或停止决策，其蒸馏也仅服务压缩，难以为 LVR 的训练监督或贡献分配提供具体线索。
